implementation_notes: Created src/study_tutor/knowledge/corpus_models.py containing: (1) SourceType(str, Enum) with the four filesystem-aligned values PRIMARY_TEXT / SECONDARY_STUDY_GUIDE / SECONDARY_CRITICAL / CONTEXT_HISTORICAL; (2) PlayCitationAnchor (kind='play', act/scene/line) and NovelCitationAnchor (kind='novel', chapter/paragraph) Pydantic v2 models with extra='forbid'; (3) CitationAnchor as a Pydantic v2 discriminated union via Annotated[Union[Play, Novel], Field(discriminator='kind')]; (4) CorpusChunk with text, source_type, source_path, text_name (Field(min_length=1)), citation_anchor: CitationAnchor | None = None, chunk_index. Module is stack-agnostic — only imports from enum, typing, and pydantic; no graphiti / chromadb / file I/O. Tests cover enum membership, str-enum identity, both anchor round-trips through model_dump/model_validate, discriminator dispatch (Play and Novel), rejection of unknown/missing kind, CorpusChunk acceptance of None and rejection of unknown source_type, citation_anchor defaulting to None, full round-trip preserving the discriminated union, rejection of empty text_name, and an AST-based check that no forbidden modules are imported.
concerns: Project uses pyproject.toml-only dependency declaration with no Ruff/Black config defined; lint check is therefore the implicit 'tests + import passes cleanly' bar. If a formatter is added later, this file follows PEP 8 / black-compatible style.
Worktree's .guardkit/venv lacks pytest, so tests were executed via the user-level pytest at ~/.local/bin/pytest with PYTHONPATH=src — same Python 3.12 + pydantic 2.12.5 the project pins to.
